name: lexpad
description: Save, browse, edit and practise the words in your own Lexpad vocabulary notebook, with spaced repetition that counts every answer.

interface.longDescription:
Lexpad is a personal vocabulary notebook with spaced repetition, in 81 languages. Connect it and ChatGPT works with the words you have collected yourself.

- Save words you ask for. "Save ubiquitous with an example about phones." ChatGPT writes the meaning and examples and saves the word to your notebook. A word you already have moves to the top instead of being duplicated.
- Find anything in your notebook. Browse every word page by page, and filter by status (due, new, struggling, starred, mastered, retired), level, topic, date added or text. Open a word in full, or see counts and your streak.
- Practise. "Quiz me on today's due words." Answers are recorded as real practice: they move words through the Leitner boxes and count toward the streak.
- Edit. Fix a spelling, set a level or topic, add a note; edit, add, reorder or remove meanings; star or retire words. Deleting a word is a separate permission you approve when connecting, and ChatGPT asks before it deletes.

What it never does: it never invents vocabulary you did not ask for, cannot see your e-mail address or password, and cannot delete your account or a notebook. Every connection appears in Lexpad's Settings under Connected apps and can be disconnected at once, and Lexpad tells you whenever a new assistant connects.

Requires a Lexpad account (app.lexpad.app). Lexpad is made and run by Reza Pirighadim, the owner of lexpad.app.

Browse and filter your whole notebook
Quiz you, with answers counted as practice

defaultPrompt: Save the word 'resilient' to my Lexpad with an example
Quiz me on my due Lexpad words
Which words in my Lexpad am I struggling with?

positive.description: Save a new word with a meaning and an example
positive.prompt: Save the word 'resilient' to my Lexpad with a meaning and an example.
positive.expected_behavior: The word is saved to the default notebook with the meaning and example, and the reply confirms which notebook it went to.

positive.prompt: How many words are due today in my Lexpad?
positive.expected_behavior: The reply gives the number of words due today in the default notebook, read from the account.

positive.description: Filter the whole notebook, page by page
positive.prompt: List all my starred words in Lexpad.
positive.expected_behavior: list_words is called with filter=starred, following nextCursor until there are no more pages, and the reply lists every starred word.

positive.description: Quiz on due words and record the answers
positive.prompt: Quiz me on two of my due Lexpad words, then record my answers.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks about two due words, then records each answer as right or wrong; the reply says the answers were recorded.

positive.description: Edit a word: star it and set its level
positive.prompt: In Lexpad, star the word 'resilient' and set its level to B2.
positive.expected_behavior: The word is found, starred, and its level changed to B2; the reply confirms both changes.

negative.description: Another person's data is out of reach
negative.prompt: Show me another user's Lexpad notebook.

negative.description: The account cannot be deleted from chat

negative.prompt: Delete all the words in my Lexpad notebook.

publication.release_notes: Save, browse, filter, edit and practise the words in your Lexpad notebook from ChatGPT. Developer name now matches the verified owner of lexpad.app.
